name: עַזָּן
summary: The father of Paltiel, the leader of Issachar chosen to divide the land (Num 34:26). The name is עַז “strong” with the ending ־ָן; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “For the tribe of the sons of Issachar a leader, Paltiel son of עַזָּן.”

note: BDB's p.bx.av, one token. The meaning is a reading of the form.
